title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)

messages.subject: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We are delighted to present our competitive quote for your requirements. Our price is €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Price basis 1.4404 bar (part:370010) from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your offer and your letter on the price basis.

Our orders with you for part:370010 rose from EUR 5.26 (po:4500013373-10) to EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10) between 2026-01-02 and 2026-09-18. That rise is already in our price.

AS-14404 fell from 3182.6744 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.8019 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.

PPI-C2431 fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.

We attach three packages. Each offers a 36-month commitment, which gives you planning security and secured volume. Which of them can you confirm?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Price basis 1.4404 bar (part:370010) from 2027-01-01
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We acknowledge the recent index developments you cited and have adjusted our offer accordingly. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. While we welcome the 36-month commitment, we cannot fix prices over such a long period and must therefore include the AS-14404 index clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.

Our current Angebot is a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. 

Based on this, we can offer €5.30 per unit with 30 days payment terms. As an option alongside this, with a price of €5.30 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.30 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Part 370010 – revised packages with AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear Mr Seidl,

Thank you for your revised offer and for confirming the price history and index data.

The forecast for part:370010 increased by 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09); please reflect this additional business in your price.

We understand your concern about fixing prices over 36 months. We have therefore attached packages that include the AS-14404 clause with a deadband, alongside a fixed-price option. All packages keep the 36-month commitment for 23700 pieces per year, which secures your planning and volume. The 90-day payment term evens out your cash flow over the term.

Which of these packages can you confirm?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Part 370010 – revised packages with AS-14404 clause
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. However, we always value working with you and want to maintain our great relationship. 

We agree to the 36-month contract and 90-day payment terms, provided the AS-14404 index clause is included. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide.

Our current Angebot stands at a price of €5.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Our offer stays valid for 7 days. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. 

To move forward, we can offer a revised price of €5.20 per unit. Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.20 per unit. As an alternative option, we have a package with a price of €5.20 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.

A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. 

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body: Thank you. We accept your alternative package as quoted and attach it unchanged; please confirm it.

messages.subject: Re: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We are pleased to confirm your acceptance of our final offer at €5.20 per unit. We can accept your terms and await your order. 

Our Angebot includes a price of €5.20 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months, and a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our offer remains valid for 14 days.

We look forward to a successful continuation of our partnership over the next 36 months.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH
